proposals.name: evalEvaluate
proposals.evidence: strupr(str)=init_str, read_token, expression loop over LT..NEQ tokens 8-13 (logical_expression inlined); *err=SYNTAX(3) if token!=EOL(0x29) else exiterr; HW1 Eval.c:703

proposals.name: read_token
proposals.evidence: Skips spaces via ctype table, sets cur_token per char (')'->5, '!='->NEQ 0xd, bad char -> _ERROR 0x28 with exiterr=SYNTAX); called by all eval parse levels

proposals.name: expression
proposals.evidence: Unary minus on token 1, then loop over PLUS(0)/MINUS(1) calling multiply; returns 0 on _ERROR; HW1 Eval.c:365

proposals.name: multiply
proposals.evidence: Loop over MULT(2)/DIV(3) calling factor; divide by 0 sets _ERROR and exiterr=DIV_ZERO(1); HW1 Eval.c:409

proposals.name: factor
proposals.evidence: Only user of 'C:\Cataclysm\src\game\eval.c' assert path; dispatches math fns (pow, CRT trig, ranRandomFn for RAND/RND), recurses into expression; HW1 Eval.c:449

proposals.name: evalNum2Str
proposals.evidence: n>1E12 -> sprintf %f, else sprintf '%12.12f' and strip trailing zeros and '.', strdel inlined; HW1 Eval.c:943

proposals.name: cur_token
proposals.evidence: Token global written by read_token, tested against 0x28 _ERROR / 0x29 EOL in every parse level

proposals.name: exiterr
proposals.evidence: Zeroed in evalEvaluate, set 1 (DIV_ZERO) in multiply and 3 (SYNTAX) in read_token, copied to *err

proposals.name: func_vector
proposals.evidence: 12-byte {int id; char name[8]} rows: ASIN @0x87bc88, ATAN @0x87bc94, FACT @0x87bce8, RAND @0x87bd48 = HW1 alphabetical func_vector (ACOS first)
